annotations.title: Change a server's name, size or settings

description: Changes a server's name, size, settings, player lists, content, auto-start or custom domain. Omitted fields are kept, and a sent list replaces the stored one (uploaded files excepted). Not for the resource pack (setResourcePack) or a fresh world (resetServer). The returned server says when a restart is required (restartToApplySettings); a larger size costs more per running hour.

autoStartEnabled.description: Whether a player joining an asleep server starts it. On by default.

allowFlight.description: Let players fly in survival without being kicked; default off.

bannedIps.description: IP addresses that are banned from joining.

expires.description: ISO 8601 time or forever; forever when omitted.

source.description: Who issued it; Server when omitted.

bannedPlayers.description: Players who are banned from joining.

expires.description: ISO 8601 time or forever; forever when omitted.

source.description: Who issued it; Server when omitted.

bedrockEnabled.description: Also let Bedrock Edition players on phones, consoles and Windows join. Works only on a type and version inside getBedrockRange.

enableCommandBlock.description: Command blocks run; the default depends on the Minecraft version.

forceGamemode.description: Put players in gamemode every time they join; default off.

hardcore.description: One life; dead players become spectators. Default off.

icon.description: Server list icon as a base64 data URI of a 64x64 PNG.

levelSeed.description: Applies only to a world not yet generated; use resetServer to regenerate.

levelType.description: Generator for a new world: flat, largebiomes, amplified; unset is normal.

maxPlayers.description: Most players online at once; default 20.

modpack.description: A Modrinth or CurseForge modpack to run, downloaded from that site when the server starts. An uploaded .mrpack is set through the modpack upload operations instead.

coord.description: Modrinth or CurseForge project id of the modpack.

motd.description: Message shown under the server name in the multiplayer list.

onlineMode.description: Only players signed in with an official Minecraft account can join. On by default.

ops.description: Players with operator rights, who can run admin commands in game.

level.description: Operator level 1 to 4; 4 runs every command.

playerIdleTimeout.description: Minutes before an idle player is disconnected; 0 never disconnects.

projects.description: Mods, plugins and datapacks to install from Modrinth, CurseForge or a direct download link, which the server downloads when it starts. A string is a Modrinth project id; an object names its source (modrinth, curseforge or url) and coord (the project id or the link). A Modrinth datapack uses the coord datapack:<project id> with kind datapack. Uploaded files are managed through the asset upload operations and kept as they are.

pvp.description: Players can hurt each other; default on.

resourcePackRequired.description: Disconnect players who decline the server's resource pack.

serverImage.description: Java runtime. Leave unset: it is chosen from the version and content. Set only when the user asks for a Java version; java8 runs Minecraft older than 1.17.

simulationDistance.description: How far from players the world keeps running, in chunks.

spawnProtection.description: Radius in blocks around spawn where only operators can build.

type.description: Server software: VANILLA, a mod loader (FABRIC, FORGE, NEOFORGE, QUILT) or a plugin server (PAPER and its forks). It decides which mods or plugins can be installed.

version.description: Minecraft version such as 1.21.4; leave unset for the latest release. For a type other than VANILLA it must be listed for that type in getLoaderVersions.

viewDistance.description: How far players can see, in chunks.

voiceChatEnabled.description: Turn on proximity voice chat; players need the matching voice chat mod.

voiceChatProvider.description: Which voice chat mod is used when voice chat is on; players need the same mod.

whitelist.description: Players allowed to join while whitelistEnabled is on.

whitelistEnabled.description: Only players on the whitelist or operators can join. On when unset.

customDomain.description: A domain the user owns, used to join instead of the Pixly address. After setting it, point its DNS and call verifyCustomDomain.

enabled.description: false stops routing the domain to this server.

host.description: Domain the owner controls, such as play.example.com, pointed at the server with a CNAME record.

name.description: Display name; also used in the join address.

resetWorld.description: Set true only after the user agrees to wipe the world, for a Minecraft version downgrade or a server type change that needs a new world. A backup is taken first. Never set it on your own.

size.description: New size class (prices in getPricingCatalog; larger sizes cost more per running hour). Applies at the next start or restartServer.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.

name: updateServer
title: Change a server's name, size or settings
